sections.section_content:
1/2 Tabata of:
* **Squats**
* **Push-ups**
* **Pull-ups**

Rest one minute between efforts.
section_notes: Maintain high intensity during the work intervals.
Ensure full range of motion on push-ups and pull-ups.

sections.section_content:
3 Rounds for time:
* **Run** 400 meters
* **Deadlift** (Bodyweight) x 15 reps
* **Box Jump** (24”) x 20 reps
section_notes: This workout focuses on three different functional applications of hip extension.
Maintain a steady pace and avoid unnecessary delays between movements.

metadata.raw_content:
Complete three rounds for time:  
Run 400 meters  
Deadlift bodyweight X 15 reps  
24” [Box Jump ](http://media.crossfit.com/cf-video/boxjump.wmv)X 20 reps  
  
  
This workout contains three different functional applications of hip extension. Note the seeming incompatibility of these movements. The benefit here is largely a function of pace or total time – don’t dally!

sections.section_content:
Complete the following:
* **Shoulder Press** (15 RM) x 15 reps
* **Pull-ups** x 20 reps
* **Push Press** (15 RM) x 15 reps
* **Pull-ups** x 20 reps
* **Push Jerk** (15 RM) x 15 reps
* **Pull-ups** x 20 reps
section_notes: Work at a pace that allows for max load.
Complete each round of pull-ups in as few sets as possible.
The load should increase from Shoulder Press to Push Press to Push Jerk.

Work at a pace that allows for max load. Complete each round of pull-ups in as few sets as possible.   
  
The load for the presses should increase from the shoulder press to the push press to the push jerk. The progression of these presses is from lesser to greater functionality, max load, metabolic stimulus, and total body involvement.

sections.section_content:
* 50 **Glute Ham Sit-ups**
* Tabata "Bottom to Bottom" **Squats**
* 50 **Abmat Sit-ups**
section_notes: For the Bottom to Bottom Squat, each rep begins and ends at the bottom with no pause at the top.
The ten-second rest intervals in the Tabata are also held at the bottom of the squat.

metadata.raw_content:
50 [Glute Ham Sit-ups](http://media.crossfit.com/cf-video/glutehamsitup.wmv)  
[Tabata ](http://media.crossfit.com/cf-video/sample2tabata.wmv)“Bottom to Bottom” [Squats](http://media.crossfit.com/cf-video/sample2tabata.wmv)  
50 Abmat Sit-ups  
  
The Tabata Bottom to Bottom Squat is a Tabata Squat but each rep begins at the bottom and ends at the bottom. The turn around at the top is immediate - no pause. The ten-second rest for each interval is also held at the bottom of the squat as opposed to the top. Interestingly, this squat, in contrast to the “normal” Tabata squat, motivates full hip extension. Also, the ten second rests don’t seem as short with this protocol!
